# Status Text

A one-word status, at the scale where there is room for nothing else.

In `library/components/status-text/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-status`

## ARIA

- **the glyph** — `aria-hidden=true`
- **the list, never the label** — `role=status`

**States:** ok, err, muted, compact

## Goes wrong when

- the glyph aria-hidden and nothing else in the label, which announces an empty string
- a tick from CSS content, folded into the name as punctuation standing in for a word
- a character whose Unicode name nobody chose and no translator will ever see
- title on a span nobody can focus: no keyboard, no touch, announced inconsistently
- a live region per label, so four rows changing is four queued announcements
- display:none on the word at narrow widths, which removes it from the tree with its layout box

## API

- `AC.createStatusText(root) -> { set, refresh, destroy }`
- `AC.setStatus(el, tone, word)`

WCAG 1.3.1 1.4.1 1.4.11 1.4.13 4.1.3 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/live-regions/) · see also `notice`, `badge`, `live-region`
